summary: Phase-2 (Career Launchpad Phase 1.5) backend testing complete. All 17 pytest tests passed (17/17 = 100%) covering: sales scenarios list, sales/turn opener+follow-up+auto-end+404, sales/score-session 5-axis report, resume/parse happy-path + 400/413/422 error paths, resume/interview-questions with resume-grounded questions, regression smokes (tmay/roadmap/speaking), and per-user 30/day quota guard (429 with detail.code='user_quota_exceeded') across all 4 new endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_routes.py is now ~1423 lines — even more urgent to split into modules (sales.py, resume.py, etc.). Recommend doing this before Phase 3.

sales_turn / resume_parse / resume_interview_questions are hardcoded to a single provider (gpt-5.2 or claude-sonnet-4-6) with no fallback chain (unlike tutor_chat which uses _send_with_fallback). A single provider outage 500s these new endpoints. Suggest wrapping them in _send_with_fallback as well.

RESUME_QUESTIONS_SYSTEM enforces 8-10 questions but there is no server-side retry/backfill if the LLM under-returns (unlike roadmap_generate which backfills to 30 days). Consider adding a pad-or-retry guard so the response always lands in the 8-10 range.

_extract_pdf_text raises HTTPException 400 for any pypdf failure but the size-limit check (413) runs after the file is fully read into memory — for very large uploads this still consumes RAM. Consider streaming size validation via UploadFile.size if available, or stream-read with an early break.
resume_parse 'empty PDF' guard uses len(raw_text) < 40 — a noisy scanned PDF that extracts a few characters could slip past. Consider tightening to <80 or also checking unique-character count.

from pypdf import PdfReader is imported at module-bottom inside the file (line 1196) which works but violates PEP-8 import ordering and may delay import errors until first request after restart. Move to top alongside other imports.
Sales scenarios list is an in-memory constant — fine for now, but means scenarios can't be A/B-tested or extended without a code push. Consider moving to a config file / mongo collection later.
test_credentials: None required — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY already in backend/.env. Tests use synthetic X-User-Id values like qa-sales-<rand>, qa-resume-<rand>, qa-quota-<rand>.
seed_data_creation: Quota tests seed the user_usage MongoDB collection with one doc per test (uid=qa-quota-<rand>, calls=limit) and delete it in teardown. No persistent data left in DB. PDF fixtures are built in-memory via reportlab BytesIO; no temp files written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_endpoints.py is reusable (17 tests, ~165s full run). Phase-1 file /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_endpoints.py is also still valid. Both can be run together with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. The auto-end sales test (test_sales_turn_auto_end_after_target) issues 4 sequential LLM calls (~30s total). Resume happy-path + non-pdf + 413 + 422 ordering matters less — they're independent. The 4 quota-guard parametrized tests cover sales_turn/sales_score_session/resume_parse/resume_interview_questions endpoints. All endpoints honoured the X-Is-Premium: true bypass during functional tests, and X-Is-Premium: false + seeded user_usage triggered 429s as expected.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Backend Phase-2 is production-ready from a functional/contract standpoint. Code-quality items listed in critical_code_review_comments are non-blocking improvements.
